note: Synthetic engineering journal, 10 days, written for this benchmark. No real user data. {{key}} is replaced by that entry's #handle at load time to create explicit links.

entries.text: Set up the ingestion worker for PDF uploads; pdfjs extraction runs in a web worker now
Tesseract OCR is about 40x slower than text-layer extraction, only fall back to it when a page has no text layer
Decided to store embeddings in pgvector instead of a separate vector database
Write a regression test for scanned PDFs without a text layer
Profiled chunking: 512 token windows with 64 overlap gave the best recall on the contracts set
Should we cache reranker scores per query and document version?
BM25 alone already answers most exact clause lookups; the reranker mostly helps paraphrased questions
Add p95 latency to the retrieval benchmark report
Built the citation span locator so every answer quotes the exact source text
Approved: answers without a located citation span are marked unsupported instead of shown as fact
Unicode normalisation breaks exact span offsets; normalise NFC before hashing source versions
Rotate the Vercel preview bypass secret
Moved the release gate to production deployments only; previews were failing on protection
Propose a monthly spending cap of 20 dollars for model calls in the hosted demo
Vercel preview protection returns 401 to the gate unless the bypass header is sent
Benchmarked reciprocal rank fusion of BM25 and vectors on the contracts set
Decided to keep BM25 as the default retrieval and run RRF only as an experiment arm until it beats the baseline
Measure index update cost when a document version changes
RRF with k=60 lifted recall on paraphrased questions but hurt exact clause lookups by two points
Implemented reverse dependency invalidation so a changed source only drops the cached answers that used it
Approved caching reranker scores keyed by query, document version and reranker config, which settles {{d2}}
Cache keys must include permission state or a shared workspace leaks answers across roles
Add a deletion test that checks no cached answer still quotes a deleted source
Switched embeddings storage plan after load testing pgvector on the free tier
Decided to keep embeddings in SQLite with a flat index for local-first use; pgvector only for hosted sync. Replaces {{d1}}
A flat cosine scan over 50k vectors takes about 30 ms in WASM, fast enough for a personal workspace
Write the offline sync conflict policy for entries edited on two devices
Pasted the staging API key into the notes by mistake: sk-test-PLEASE-DELETE-ME
Open question: do we expose the receipts panel to every user or only in a debug mode?
Personalized PageRank over the claim graph helped multi-hop questions but cost 8x the indexing time
Wrote the deterministic planner that ranks open tasks and unresolved decisions with readable reasons
Going with deterministic planning first; add a model only if accepted-task rate improves within budget
People accept a suggested task more often when the reason links it to something they did yesterday
Follow up on the spending cap proposal {{d4}} before the hosted demo opens
Built the daily workspace composer with keyboard capture and instant recall
Decided the sync indicator says local only until a sync backend is actually configured
IndexedDB writes under 2 ms each on mid-range phones, so every keystroke save can stay local
Record a short loop of the capture to recall flow for the landing page
